title: Modular proportional type-scale and elevation synthesis for tokens
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: The current token set has drifted into multiple parallel patterns: a fixed step type scale that compresses at small sizes, shadow stacks that conflict with chart layer semantics, and inconsistent radius values across buttons and table rows. This makes cross-product layouts feel uneven and makes it difficult to build density-aware components for Dedicated and Private customers.

Goal: Create a modular, proportionate type scale and a synthesized elevation system that: (1) maps to semantic intent (foreground, surface, overlay, chart-layer), (2) interpolates spacing/radius proportionally so components scale smoothly between compact and default densities, and (3) consolidates shadow/elevation tokens into a predictable stack optimized for accessibility and chart legibility.

Scope:
- Define a proportional type scale (ratio-based) with anchored tokens for micro/compact/small/normal/large.
- Introduce semantic elevation tokens (e.g., elevation.surface, elevation.overlay, elevation.chart-base, elevation.chart-peak) and a shadow-synthesis guideline for light/dark modes.
- Rework radius tokens into a proportional system (radius.base, radius.control, radius.container) with fluid interpolation for compact mode.
- Update spacing tokens to align with the proportional scale so rhythm remains consistent when type size changes.
- Provide migration guidance: token alias map, codemod strategy, and canary rollout plan in Console.

Acceptance criteria:
- New tokens documented in Figma and token spec with examples for buttons, tables, and charts.
- Contrast and accessibility checks pass for primary/secondary surface combinations (WCAG AA for text, AAA where practical).
- Engineering receives a codemod + manifest and a targeted migration for components in the component library.
- Two example pages (dashboard and dense table) showing before/after visuals and performance notes are available.
- Rollout plan (canary by product area, automated A/B monitoring) created and aligned with PM and ENG owners.

Out of scope: full component re-skin for all legacy apps. This is token-level modernization with targeted component examples.

2026-03-01 — Prototype: Generated proportional scale variants in Figma, initial shadow-synthesis sketches show improved chart readability at 8px line-height densities.
2026-03-05 — Design review: Requested clearer naming for semantic elevation tokens; removed ambiguous 'depth-x' nomenclature. Action: update token names and publish spec draft.
2026-03-09 — Accessibility pass: Ran token pairs through contrast tool; flagged elevation.overlay on dark mode for additional contrast adjustment. Action: tweak overlay tint and re-test.
